email.body1:
Alfred, saw Fiery launched the FS700 Pro platform and JobFlow Pro, plus the custom DFE for Xerox's Proficio presses.

A launch wave like that usually opens more accounts than the sales team can cover before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Fiery off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alfred, quick follow-up for Fiery.

Multiple launches fill the funnel, but most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to convert that interest into pipeline. The gap shows up late, and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alfred, last bit of proof for Fiery.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Fiery's reply rate likely compares to other print-software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alfred, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A launch-heavy stretch is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a print-software motion? I'll tailor it to Fiery either way.
